notes.title: Capsoul is here – Time to jump, fall, and rise again!
notes.notes: [h2][b]🎉 Capsoul is now available on Steam![/b][/h2][p]Capsoul is a challenging 3D platformer with no checkpoints, no hand-holding, and no forgiveness. Every jump is a risk. Every fall — a lesson. And every victory? Fully earned.[/p][p]You play as a small capsule with a soul — literally — climbing through a ruined world full of floating platforms, forgotten relics, and your own persistence.[/p][p]There are no tutorials. No tricks. Just skill, patience, and a very precise jump button.[/p]

notes.title: Capsoul is in Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Hi there![/p][p]I’m taking part in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] with my game, [b]Capsoul[/b].[/p][p]It’s a 3D platformer where you play as a capsule with a mustache and a shower cap, trying to get through some strange and slightly absurd levels.[/p][p]The demo has:[/p][list][*][p]Tight platforming with limited lives[/p][/*][*][p]A miniboss encounter[/p][/*][*][p]Some weird surprises[/p][/*][/list][p]The demo isn’t long, but it should give you a good idea of the mood and gameplay.[/p][p]If you enjoy it, feel free to [b]leave feedback[/b] or [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] — that kind of support goes a long way during events like this.[/p][p]Thanks for checking it out![/p]

notes.title: Capsoul Demo v0.4.0 is live! Now with tutorial and improvements
notes.notes:
Hey!

I've just updated the [b]Capsoul demo[/b] to version 0.4.0 — and it's got some fresh stuff inside.

🔧 [b]What’s new[/b]:

Added a proper in-game tutorial

Improved UI and feedback in several places

A couple of sneaky secret spots to discover

Minor gameplay additions and quality-of-life touches

The levels themselves are mostly the same, but the experience feels more alive now. There’s a bit more clarity, a bit more weirdness, and hopefully, a bit more fun.

If you've played before — feel free to revisit.
If this is your first time — good luck. Capsy believes in you. Kind of.

Thanks for checking out the game, and as always — wishlists help a lot!

notes.title: Bug or Feature? Capsy Learns to Fly
notes.notes:
🪲 [b]Unexpected Flight Lessons – Bug or Feature?[/b]

Capsy was supposed to land.  
He didn’t.  
And honestly? I kinda loved it.

Some bugs are frustrating.  
Some are dangerous.  
And some — like this one — are just hilarious.

This glitch is already fixed in the next update, but it gave me one of the best accidental moments while testing the game.

🎮 [Play the free demo on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665880/Capsoul/)  
🛒 Wishlist if you enjoy chaos, platforming, or mustaches.

I'm making [b]Capsoul[/b] solo — one level, one bug, one boss at a time.  
Next stop: [b]Steam Next Fest[/b].

Capsy has no legs, but that never stopped him from taking off.

notes.title: 🎉 The Capsoul Demo is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Capsoul Demo is live on Steam now![/h1]

Yes, it’s finally here. You can now play as a capsule with a mustache and a shower cap. [b]Why?[/b] Nobody knows. Not even him.

Explore two full levels where small dragons are weirdly aggressive, platforms have never heard of workplace safety, and you can shift into an alternate world — which might help you… or just mess with your plans for fun. At the end of it all? A boss who’s just as annoyed to see you as you are to fight him.

This is a solo-developed platformer — fast, challenging, and occasionally stylish.

---

[h2]🕹️ Try the demo now:[/h2]

         👉 [Play the demo on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665880/Capsoul/)


---

[h2]What’s inside:[/h2]

- [b]Two full levels[/b] of action and awkward heroism  
- [b]A boss fight[/b] with wings and explosion issues  
- [b]A couple of secrets[/b], if you’re nosy  
- [b]Zero checkpoints.[/b] If you die, you start over. I’m sorry (not really)

---

Feedback, thoughts, bug reports, or emotionally-charged screams are welcome.  
[b]Thanks for playing. The capsule believes in you.[/b]
